queueBindings.producerSummary: Import API and import chunk/equipment/file-batch helpers. Seven direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: companyId + importSessionId; session lookup checks both. Child commit payloads carry tenant and lineage identifiers.
queueBindings.behavior: CSV mapping/validation/execution plus four chunk commit handlers. AI/storage dependencies are outside this outbound subset. `migrate-file-batch` producers have an unwired standalone processor (W1).

queueBindings.producerSummary: Estimate, invoice, job, agreement and import services; worker fan-out; import-file-link helper. Eleven direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Per-entity jobs use companyId. Scheduled summary/dormant jobs intentionally accept `{}` and enumerate tenants internally.
queueBindings.behavior: Opportunity evaluation, follow-up/recovery checks, summary computation, batch/dormant scans and file linking; no direct customer send in this dispatcher. Global dormant scan is not the tenant-only #436 button contract.

queueBindings.producerSummary: API services, invoice/agreement workers, Stripe handler and VIP helper. Twenty-one direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Most jobs carry companyId and entity IDs; some handlers consume queued recipient/template fields without reloading the customer. Per-path boundaries below.
queueBindings.behavior: Sixteen recognized job names reach email/SMS seams. Actual delivery requires a configured provider; disabled/no-op paths still resolve successfully.

queueBindings.producerSummary: Invoice send service and reminder processor. Two direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Invoice lookup uses companyId + invoiceId; automation rule lookup is tenant-scoped.
queueBindings.behavior: Overdue check and reminder levels 1–3 enqueue notification jobs. No direct provider handoff; unpaid state/rule/timestamps rechecked.

queueBindings.producerSummary: Bootstrap reminder scan and loyalty candidate helper. Two direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Per-plan/loyalty jobs carry companyId. Global plan-reminder scan enumerates companies internally.
queueBindings.behavior: Loyalty candidates, plan-reminder scan and service-agreement-renewal-check dispatch. No direct named enqueue of renewal-check found in the 52-call set; its handler can enqueue renewal email. API compiled service import is required.

queueBindings.producerSummary: Clerk workspace create/reconcile helpers. Two direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Pretenant exception: strict intentId + clerkUserId payload; intent claim verifies that identity. No company exists yet.
queueBindings.behavior: Clerk organization provision/reconcile state machine. This queue is separate from HTTP Twilio/Stripe webhook ingestion. Unknown provider outcomes reconcile rather than blindly repeat organization creation.

queueBindings.producerSummary: QBO push/pull helpers, service-brief helper and retention proposal enqueue. Four direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Payloads include companyId; delegated QBO/service-brief processors own scoped data access. Retention defaults to no evaluation input.
queueBindings.behavior: QBO sync, job service brief and retention gate dispatch. Retention default dormancy and missing proposal-create dispatcher case are W2; no customer-send completion is inferred.

queueBindings.producerSummary: Tenant export create/retry API. Two direct calls.
queueBindings.tenantBinding: Loads export session, checks session.companyId equals payload companyId, then gathers tenant data.
queueBindings.behavior: Completed session skips; progress/status/event updates and storage upload to company-prefixed key. Initial check is not an atomic execution claim; export runtime isolation was not run.

queueBindings.tenantBinding: companyId + scanId lookup; completed scan skips; public-scan feature flag gates work.
queueBindings.behavior: Bounded public URL fetch through shared outbound URL guard, rubric findings and progress/events. Public target URL does not mean tenant-free scan state.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: companyId + estimateId + customerId; tenant reload, matching customer, sent status, email and approval token.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: No fresh preference/ledger check in this handler.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Three attempts; no stable jobId at these enqueue sites; no pre-send delivery claim observed.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Reload campaign recipient under companyId; verify customerId and recipient.sentAt; destination/body come from job.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Producer excludes doNotContact; worker does not recheck full customer consent/global phone opt-out before its provider call.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Stable campaign/recipient queue ID plus sentAt check; mark-delivered occurs after provider result. Check-before-send is not an atomic exactly-once guarantee; failures rethrow.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: companyId/invoice/customer reload; sent, partially_paid or overdue status; payment link and email required.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: No fresh preference/ledger check in this handler.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Three attempts; no stable queue ID at this call; no pre-send delivery claim observed.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Tenant invoice/customer context plus paymentId/amount. Receipt claim keyed by company/payment.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: isReceiptEmailAllowed checked by producer and worker: address present, doNotContact not true, prefersEmail not false; null preference is allowed by this receipt policy.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Stable payment jobId, three attempts, durable sending claim with 10-minute stale takeover; release on send failure. Mark-sent failure logs. Provider timeout/claim expiry still prevents an exactly-once claim.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Tenant invoice/customer reload, enabled rule, unpaid state, payment link and reminder-level timestamp. Level 3 also resolves company owner.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: No full customer preference/ledger decision observed in reminder handler.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Automatic stage ID stable; manual ID timestamped. Email then optional owner alert then reminder timestamp. A later failure can permit a prior side effect to repeat.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Tenant maintenance-plan/customer/company reload; renewal requires enabled rule; payment-failure path loads owner.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Renewal requires email/rule; no fresh full preference/ledger gate observed. Owner operational alert has a different recipient/purpose.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Three attempts. Renewal ID fixed per plan, webhook payment-failure call lacks stable ID here; send-time exactly-once not established.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Alias to same handler; payload must still supply supported emailType and maintenancePlanId/companyId.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Same observed handler checks; not a separate integrated consent mechanism.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Recognized dispatch alias; no production literal producer found in the inspected source search. Do not claim this name executes in production.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Producer loads tenant job/technician/customer; worker uses queued companyId, customerPhone and message.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Generic SMS helper has no fresh customer/preference/global-opt-out lookup.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Producer rejects another same-day recorded notification, and records sentAt/event before enqueue; that is not a provider receipt. No stable jobId supplied here.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: When companyId/reviewRequestId are present, production dependency reloads request/customer and invoice context. Destination/template remains partly queued.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Fresh doNotContact and preference===true; invoice-originated path also requires paid positive invoice and enabled rule. Missing identifier legacy shape can bypass contextual recheck and take generic SMS helper; preserve as coverage follow-up.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Paid-invoice producer has per-invoice lock/event guard and stable jobId/delay; other producers do not pass a stable ID here. Existing request-state checks do not prove provider deduplication.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Producer resolves company owner/staff recipients; worker uses queued email/phones/template.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Operational recipients; producer SMS decision uses configured flag, not a confirmed live registry channel. No customer-consent claim is appropriate.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Once claim + hourly company rate limit + stable entity ID; per-phone loop can partially succeed before failure. Default retries do not prove one delivery each.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Tenant plan/customer/rule reload in production; matching customer and active, nondeleted plan required.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Fresh doNotContact and channel preference===true. This is the observed preference policy, not the proposed authoritative contact/purpose ledger.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Fixed reminder jobId at producer; rule/active checks repeated. Payload destination/template plus provider result remains outside an atomic consent/send transaction.

outboundPaths.providerBoundary: S for normal staff alert; E if email-shaped payload
outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Booking producer builds tenant staff phone payloads; generic helper requires companyId, phone, body. Self-service cancellation producer supplies companyId/bookingRequestId/body without recipient.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: No fresh booking/customer lookup in this handler; staff alert purpose differs from customer appointment consent.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Source self-service alert shape will take missing-recipient skip path in the inspected handler; record as W3. No stable jobId at these call sites.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Queued toEmail/companyName/referenceNumber determine email; companyId/bookingRequestId used for optional post-send message log, not a fresh context lookup.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Email-first; missing email-shaped fields skip. No fresh booking consent/recipient lookup in handler.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Message-log source tuple dedupes logging after send; it does not prevent resend. Default retry applies.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Same queued booking email shape; decline template selected by job name.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Email-first; no fresh booking consent/recipient lookup in handler.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Post-send log dedupe only; default retry; missing email shape skips.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Auth producer creates reset token and queues companyId/toEmail/resetUrl; worker validates presence and uses payload.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: Authentication message; not evidence of marketing opt-in. No tenant reload inside handler.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: No stable jobId/pre-send claim here. Enqueue error is caught/logged by auth service; successful request flow is not proof of delivery. Queue payload includes sensitive reset link.

outboundPaths.tenantAndRecipientBinding: Worker reloads live customer by company/id and company; requires email. Stripe subscription/invoice or stable job fallback supplies log source key.
outboundPaths.consentObservation: No fresh customer preference/ledger check observed in welcome, renewal or dunning handler. Purpose-specific owner decision remains required.
outboundPaths.idempotencyAndVisibility: Helper stable subscription/invoice/step IDs; post-send conflict-safe message log, not pre-send claim. Stripe VIP handler is the upstream caller; default retries/delays do not prove exactly once.

findings.title: produced file-batch job is not routed by registered imports consumer
findings.evidence: [producer](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/packages/jobs/src/enqueue-migrate-file-batch.ts#L21) and [retry producer](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/packages/jobs/src/enqueue-migrate-file-batch-retry.ts#L32) enqueue `migrate-file-batch`. [standalone processor](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/migrate-file-batch.processor.ts#L195) exists, but [registered dispatcher](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/csv-import.processor.ts#L1319) has no matching case/import, and bootstrap registers processCsvImport.
findings.followUpAcceptance: Existing import/file-migration owners should wire the intended processor once. Acceptance: a representative produced job passes through the actual bootstrap-selected dispatcher to the file-batch processor; tenant/idempotency payload validation remains intact; unexpected names fail or emit an explicit observable unsupported outcome. No live lost-job incident is claimed.

findings.title: retention is dormant by default and its proposal target is not handled
findings.evidence: [default dependencies](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/retention-gates.processor.ts#L30) returns null evaluation input and enqueues `proposal.create.customer_message` at line 33. [dispatcher](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/retention-gates.processor.ts#L182) handles QBO, two retention gates and job brief, with default return; it has no proposal-create case.
findings.followUpAcceptance: Existing retention/operator contract owners should choose explicit dormant behavior or supply approved evaluation input and the intended proposal consumer. Acceptance: test default null input as no-op; enabled valid input reaches exactly the intended proposal handler; unknown names are visibly rejected/recorded; no provider send is introduced by proposal creation.

findings.title: self-service cancellation alert lacks a recipient in the observed producer
findings.evidence: [producer](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/api/src/services/booking-self-service.service.ts#L640) supplies companyId, bookingRequestId and body. [booking handler](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/notifications.processor.ts#L1858) falls back to [SMS helper](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/notifications.processor.ts#L525), which requires a phone and skips otherwise.
findings.followUpAcceptance: Booking owner should confirm intended staff notification and supply/reload its authorized recipient or emit an explicit suppressed outcome. Acceptance: cancellation alert has a bounded recipient contract and test proving queue-to-handler outcome; avoid labeling skipped work delivered.

findings.title: consent/opt-out coverage differs across outbound paths
findings.evidence: The complete 16-row register separates fresh checks, producer-only checks and payload-only handlers. Current SMS provider seam is disabled; #430/#431 proposed controls are not integrated.
findings.followUpAcceptance: Use these rows as coverage inputs for the existing consent/STOP work. Acceptance: exact tenant/contact/channel/purpose policy where required, changed/revoked recipient before handoff, global STOP, replay and concurrent send boundary; each refusal has an observable non-delivery result. Preserve purpose distinctions for owner/security/transactional messages.

findings.title: retry and sent records are weaker than exactly-once delivery
findings.evidence: [receipt claim/send](https://github.com/SimonShaun2/Renvani/blob/b45b4996b64b16859e44a79b171b11cbe52c3e6a/apps/worker/src/processors/notifications.processor.ts#L1268) provides a stronger pre-send claim for receipts; campaign timestamps and booking/VIP logs are checked/written at different times. No general provider idempotency token was observed at E/S.
findings.followUpAcceptance: Processor/outbox owners retain FS-15/FS-81 responsibility. Acceptance: defined duplicate semantics for provider timeout, worker crash, stale claim and partial multi-recipient success; prove provider result versus stub/no-op and reconcile uncertain sends. Do not infer exactly-once from stable queue ID.

findings.title: worker relies on compiled API modules
findings.evidence: Notification and plan-reminder loaders import API dist modules at runtime.
findings.followUpAcceptance: Worker/build owner should verify the actual deployment artifact resolves those imports and runtime dependencies, then execute isolated provider-stub smoke checks. No deployment was changed here.
